purpose: Reviewable offline export candidates, exact-byte acquisition references and associations; final Cherax catalog is not modified.
completeness: Selected exporter run completed; only accepted stable valid local envelopes were inspected. Missing/restricted/deleted history is not proven complete.

policy.lua: Source attachments may be acquired; every Lua card stays pending/files[] and has no visible Discord link.
policy.previews: Only exact acquired-image assetKey/SHA256 matches with eligible visual QA and explicit item/source-post association receive staged source preview paths. Videos, source projects and ineligible images are never previews. Files remain retained.
policy.signatures: Container/header or text syntax only. Resource compatibility and payload safety are not established by signatures.
policy.hashes: Target names use SHA-256 of actual saved bytes; publisher hashes are not reused.
policy.largeFiles: Full original retained locally. Files at least 104857600 bytes publish 95000000-byte binary parts and a reconstruction/checksum manifest.
policy.video: Showcase/ambiguous videos remain acquired media-only review records. Only explicitly labelled animated-wallpaper video sources remain format-labelled resource candidates; no video is an image preview.
